title: Enlivened End
description: brings me life to the end with new blocks, biomes, items, and mobs, all in a vanilla-style way
body:
_the features of this mod include but are not limited to…_

### **The chorus forest**:

purple wood and grass, alongside chorus daisies and chorus blooms.

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_e1878df7-b667-4ef7-8df8-4edff3fb4444.png)

### **The crystal valley**:

covered is four different types of crystals, Ceravonic, zeilonic, fiolic, and zoltic.

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_86293b1d-6b6a-4112-a6db-08293cc9e412.png)

### **Lithium**:

found in the end as ore, and can be mined to yield chunks.

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_ef735c5f-0c1e-4356-9081-d86d9f80b71a.png)

### **Yttrium**:

can be mined for crystals that are used to make lasers and reinforced glass ![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_35834f61-e422-43d4-9c59-0741a008beb8.png)

### **Lasers**:

an end-game redstone system. Laser emitters send out lasers that can travel up to 256 blocks away. Laser detectors emit a redstone when a laser is in front of them.

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_15738d78-bd75-4aa9-825b-66a1468b8da2.png)
